services.name: Curated exhibits
services.desc: Phase one of The Growing Wall Sculpture Project was installed in 2021. The pieces from this project reunite artists who are members of the Worcester Center for Crafts family, past and present, who have served as faculty, visiting artists, or artist-in-residents at the Center. The participating artists have expressed their work by handcrafting an 18-inch, leaf-shaped piece from ceramic, glass, or metals. The materials used in this project will represent the studios that dwell within the Worcester Center for Crafts. We hope to install phase two of the project in 2024.
